metadata.label: 2026-10-11 · outlier and special tuning
metadata.method: Isolated normal and special hit components from compiled source, using the same Shared flight model before and after authoring changes. No player input; hitstop time is excluded. Charge-tier finishers and projectile/explosion hits are separate entries. Each entry uses its own damage, including the updated Bonk air-2 damage. Fixed hitstun is preserved. Travel is shown along the launch axis; inward pulls do not show their interaction with the attacker. Full special sequences, aerial starting height, self-hit behavior and contact geometry are not reproduced. Downward sends start 3m up; later ground carry is excluded. The Dash Slash traversal/finisher fix is checked separately through real contacts.
